# Jerin M R — IT Professional Portfolio

> Terminal-styled portfolio of Jerin M R, an L1 IT Professional in Thrissur, Kerala, India, focused on networking, server administration, cloud infrastructure and cybersecurity.

The site is an interactive terminal interface. Visitors run commands such as
`cd ~`, `cat profile/*`, `ls articles/` and `nano message.txt` to browse the
profile, read technical articles and send a message.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Interactive terminal portfolio — profile, skills, experience, quick links and latest articles.
- [Articles](/article/): Technical write-ups on networking, Linux, servers, cloud and IT security.
